jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT CROSBY

Crosby is built on a simple conviction: a great legal system is the watermark of a great society — and the best legal work comes from combining human expertise with the right technology, not replacing one with the other.

Crosby is the first AI-native law firm, helping ambitious companies like Cursor, Ramp, and Cognition sign commercial contracts faster.

Legal work is both art and science, and we're mapping the frontier between the two — codifying what can be systematized, amplifying human judgment where it matters most. That's why the right way to bring AI into law isn't to sell software and walk away. It's to own the outcome together: higher-quality work, delivered faster. We build proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop workflows that change what's possible for corporate legal teams.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp).  Help us transform one of society's most important industries.





ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not your typical bizops role. Operations are core to our business and are a competitive advantage, so we are designing an ambitious, world class org.

As a member of the Operations Team at Crosby, you will take full ownership of scaling the best law firm ever built – designing and optimizing complex human-in-the-loop workflows, cracking our automation, and ensuring quality.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own mission-critical workflows that blend human and machine to deliver legal work faster and better than ever before

 - Design and implement new operational processes, from scoping to rollout, across legal delivery, quality control, training, and client success.

 - Partner with product and engineering to prototype and deploy internal tools that increase throughput and reduce error.

 - Define and operationalize Crosby’s evolving playbooks, training systems, and incentives as we scale.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 2–5 years of experience in operations, consulting, finance, or a similarly analytical and high pressure, execution-focused environment. Priority given to former founders. 

 - Deep curiosity about how things work—and how they can work better.

 - Proven ability to own complex systems or projects end-to-end, especially in ambiguous or high-stakes settings.

 - Excitement about working in-person with a team that values precision, pace, and constant reinvention.

 - An interest in law or legal services is a plus, but not required—this is an operations-first role.


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Lunch & dinner in the office every day

 - Medical insurance (multiple plan options through Anthem & Cigna)

 - HSA or FSA, depending on your plan choice

 - Dental insurance

 - Vision insurance

 - One Medical membership

 - 401(k) match

 -  In-office desk setup stipend


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Crosby is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the New York City Fair Chance Act.

Pursuant to New York Labor Law Section 194-b, the US Pay Range for this position is listed in the job post. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.title: Head of Brand
jobs.description:
ABOUT CROSBY

Crosby is built on a simple conviction: a great legal system is the watermark of a great society — and the best legal work comes from combining human expertise with the right technology, not replacing one with the other.

Crosby is the first AI-native law firm, helping ambitious companies like Cursor, Ramp, and Cognition sign commercial contracts faster.

Legal work is both art and science, and we're mapping the frontier between the two — codifying what can be systematized, amplifying human judgment where it matters most. That's why the right way to bring AI into law isn't to sell software and walk away. It's to own the outcome together: higher-quality work, delivered faster. We build proprietary tools and human-in-the-loop workflows that change what's possible for corporate legal teams.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp).  Help us transform one of society's most important industries.





ABOUT THE ROLE

Sequoia. Goldman. Wachtell. The best services firms have sterling reputations. One of their most durable moats is the incredible brand each has built over decades. At Crosby, we are building a third type of company: neither software nor services, but a neofirm.



Our brand is one of our most important assets. You will own Crosby’s brand as we remake one of the most important industries and build the best AI law firm in the world.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Brand strategy and positioning: work with the founders, head of marketing, and other stakeholders to build the foundation for what Crosby’s brand stands for. Build a brand that stands out and captures attention, while feeling premium and trustworthy.

 - Visual identity and brand system: make Crosby’s brand show up consistently across varied canvases from billboards to conference booths to how our swag feels.

 - Signature campaigns and creative direction: partner with the founders and head of marketing to develop Crosby’s next major brand campaign for 2027, building on the recognition created by the “Death of the Billable Hour.” Drive the central idea and its execution across out-of-home, digital, social, and other relevant channels.

 - Website and market-facing storytelling: help transform Crosby’s website into a more complete expression of the company, services, and technology. Shape page narratives, visual concepts, headlines, and concise brand copy with product, design, and a dedicated writer.

 - Cross functional partnership: work with design, product marketing, events, content, and other teams to consistently build affinity for Crosby’s brand with every interaction a customer or prospect has.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 4-8 years of experience building a standout brand in tech, consumer, or at an agency. This could be at an admired brand, through a standout campaign or agency project, or while building an emerging company.

 - Proven ability to build a brand from the ground up, either as the first or second hire focused on brand.

 - Exceptional taste and a clear point of view. Compelling examples of distinctive, high-quality brand work and the ability to explain why creative choices were right for the company, audience, and objective.

 - Visual fluency. The judgment to guide identity and visual expression across different formats, plus enough comfort with rough mockups or concepts to communicate direction. Being a production designer is not required.

 - Conviction and collaborative judgment. Comfort navigating strong opinions from founders, marketing, Product, Sales, and designers. The ability to defend sound creative decisions, incorporate useful feedback, and move projects forward.

 - End-to-end creative leadership. Experience translating a brand idea into campaigns, a website, customer moments, or other shipped work, with clear ownership of concept, feedback, and delivery.

 - Resourcefulness and momentum. A bias for shipping high-quality work in an evolving organization, building practical systems, and managing tradeoffs without waiting for perfect resources or direction.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Crosby was founded by Ryan (Stanford Law, Cooley, startup GC) and John (Penn, first 15 engineers at Ramp).  Help us transform one of society's most important industries.





ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the growth motion at Crosby by helping us turn raw demand into a scalable system. We are building a third type of company: neither software nor services, but a neofirm. We are rethinking tech’s growth playbook, keeping what works for our business, and dropping what is brand detractive.



You’ll own the strategy and execution that drive pipeline growth across channels: mapping our potential buyers, brainstorming creative ways to get in front of them, and constantly thinking about how to improve conversion at every step of the funnel. You’ll productize the channels that are working for us, build a single source of truth for our funnel, fix the issues our funnel reveals, and experiment to develop the investment case for strong channels we aren’t running yet.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner closely with sales to build a repeatable outbound motion: draft a prioritized target list, messaging, and sequencing; automate other ancillary touchpoints like gifting and event invites

 - Paid channels: figure out a brand accretive way to use paid channels like ads to drive awareness among buying committees

 - Experiment: come up with and execute endless campaigns to test new channels and messaging that can drive pipeline and conversion; cut the losers and double down on the winners

 - Help drive ROI at events & conferences: measure ICP and TAM overlap to prioritize conferences and dinner invites; partner with events lead to build a machine to send event invites, automate follow ups, and measure ROI

 - Analytics: track campaign performance, analyze funnel data, and own ways insights from this data can be immediately used to drive pipeline or improve funnel conversion




WHO YOU ARE

 - 2-6 years experience leading growth at a startup building marketing channels from 0-1 and scaling marketing channels from 1-10

 - Creative enough to come up with experiments, and analytical enough to measure what's working

 - High agency: you take a broad mandate and get it done. You see an opportunity in the funnel math in the morning and ship a new campaign to take advantage of it by the afternoon.

 - Willing to test unconventional ideas.

 - Great judgment: you know that Crosby is building a trusted brand as a law firm, and know the line between creative, eye-catching campaign and an idea that is harmful to our brand and goals

 - Analytical: you own CAC, conversion, activation, and payback by channel. You build the dashboards, track the funnel, and read the cohorts by yourself.

 - Low ego: you know that the best way to test hypotheses is by sending the email or building the ad creative yourself. No task is beneath you.

 - You move quickly, communicate clearly, and thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
